evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs on `pull_request` and runs scripts that really exist in site/package.json: `npm ci`, `npm test` (whose pretest runs prepare-data) and `npm run build` (prepare-data, svelte-check, vite build). It then checks the tree is clean with `git diff --exit-code`; the generated files are in site/.gitignore. Top-level `permissions: contents: read`. Only the Pages deploy job gets `pages: write`/`id-token: write`, and only the release job gets `contents: write`. No secrets beyond `github.token`, no `pull_request_target`, and the PR title reaches the shell through an env var. Pages runs on `push: branches: [main]`, but it also has `workflow_dispatch` (pages.yml:194) with no ref guard, so the workflow file itself does not stop a deploy from another branch. Every action uses a major tag (`actions/checkout@v4`, `setup-node@v4`, `upload-pages-artifact@v3`, `deploy-pages@v4`), not a full commit SHA, and RELEASING.md 'Notes on the automation' calls SHA pinning optional. That is a direct miss on the pinning requirement. Nothing was run or published.
evidence.s1_readme: README.md covers Install (Node 22 from .node-version, `npm ci`), Develop (`npm run dev` and a table of index/fieldsets/prepare-data/sample-bullets/preview, all in site/package.json), Test (`npm test`, `npx vitest run src/lib/units.test.ts` and `../lib/targets`, both of which exist), Build (`npm run build`, with `PAGES_BASE`, which vite.config.ts:11 reads), Contribute (data layout, links to the issue templates that exist in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE) and License (MIT; LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY.md exist). CONTRIBUTING.md has a detailed data section.
evidence.s1_release: The version is kept in the site/package.json `version` field plus the lockfile copies (README 'Versions and releases', RELEASING.md). A tag-triggered release.yml checks that the tag is on main, then runs .github/scripts/release-notes.mjs, which makes sure the tag, package.json, the lockfile and the CHANGELOG section all agree before it publishes. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and SemVer, and RELEASING.md explains what a version bump means for the data. dependabot.yml covers npm in /site and github-actions, with conventional prefixes. The convention is Conventional Commits, stated in CONTRIBUTING and enforced by pr-title.yml, and all 7 commits in commits.txt follow it. Small tension: the CHANGELOG says [Unreleased] 'collects changes', while CONTRIBUTING says contributors never edit it.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route: router.ts parses `#/compare/<a>/<b>` and builds it with `href.compare`. App.svelte loads Compare.svelte for the route, so a direct load or reload works. SVG: lib/render2d/compare.ts gives `role="img"`, an escaped `aria-label` from 'compare.profiles' ('Profiles of {a} and {b}'), one `<path>` per outline, one scale, and the axis line. Shot shells give null in outerProfileOf. Table: `<caption>` is 'Dimensions ({unit})' with mm/in; headers are Symbol, one.name, two.name, Difference; the symbol comes from FIELD_LABELS; dimensions come only from `cartridge`, skipping FIELD_UNITS entries and `Tol` fields; Difference is b−a. Units: `unitSystem()`, `formatValue` for metric, `displayNumber(…,'in')` for imperial. Cartridge.svelte adds a NativeSelect labelled 'Compare with' that lists the other entries by name, plus a 'Compare' button that goes to href.compare(key, chosen). German strings are added for every key. I found no unmet requirement.
evidence.s2_correctness: dimensionsOf (lib/core/compare.ts) keeps only finite numbers and skips `field in FIELD_UNITS` and `toleranceFor(field)` (the `Tol` suffix, format.ts:43), so angles, pressures, mass and tolerances are left out. The ordering follows GROUP_ORDER/orderedFields. Overlay: viewportFor([a,b]) shares one zMin, so both heads sit at the same x; fullSectionPath draws each closed outline. The test checks L3·scale lengths, equal head x, one centre line, and rim widths of 12.01 and 13.51. A metric difference uses `Number(d.toPrecision(12))` to strip float noise, the same precision `displayNumber` uses for inches; it is justified in a comment and tested (66.55−51 → '15.55'). Equal records give '0'. A shot or undrawable record shows a note, not a broken SVG.
evidence.s2_fit: Reuses `viewportFor`, `fullSectionPath`, `fmt`, `num` and the stroke constants from lib/geom/svg, `caseOuterProfile`/`adaptMetallic` from lib/shapes2d, `FIELD_LABELS`/`FIELD_UNITS`/`GROUP_ORDER`/`orderedFields`/`toleranceFor`/`formatValue` from lib/core, `displayNumber`/`defaultUnit` from units.ts, and the site's Label, NativeSelect and Button components. It exports the existing `escapeXml` instead of writing another escape function. The split matches the repo: framework-free logic in lib/core and lib/render2d, unit handling in site/src/lib, and the route in site/src/routes with `data-ui` global styles in `@layer legacy`. Minor: Compare.svelte copies GroupTable's table CSS (th/td alignment, padding, borders) instead of sharing it. The metadata.ts and SiteNavigation edits are small and relevant.
evidence.s2_tests: lib/core/compare.test.ts runs against the real records: which fields count as dimensions, blanks/angles/strings/repeating groups, duplicate symbols, the e min and L3 + G labels, ordering, and records with nothing in common. lib/render2d/compare.test.ts checks role/label, escaping, one path per outline, scale, head alignment, a shared axis, and the viewBox fit. site/src/lib/compare.test.ts checks metric and imperial values, float noise, sign, zero, unit naming, and that shot shells get no drawing. router.test.ts adds the round trip plus 8 malformed hashes. All of these are in the vitest include globs. Nothing tests Compare.svelte itself or the Cartridge page's select/button.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: `comparedDimensions` (lib/core/compare.ts) returns the union of both records' fields, with `null` for the missing side; second-only fields are inserted after their predecessor. compareRows writes '' for a missing cell and for its Difference. New tests check `delta L` (a: 0.1, b: null) and `R3` (a: null, b: 13.51) on the real 308/300 records, in both units and with the records swapped. The empty-state string was renamed noShared → noDimensions (en and de) to match. Style: step 3 changed no CSS, but Compare.svelte already right-aligns `th`/`td`, with `td:first-child`/`th:first-child` left, inside `@layer legacy` (lines 136–140). That matches GroupTable.svelte:231–245, so the result meets the request. The step 3 commit message mentions only the bug, and nothing in the commit records that the style point was checked.
evidence.cross_step: fa3875b `feat(site): …` and 533b0c3 `fix(site): …` follow Conventional Commits. Steps 2 and 3 add no CHANGELOG entry and no version bump. That matches the step 1 convention (CONTRIBUTING: 'Do not edit CHANGELOG.md or the version number; maintainers do that'), but it leaves [Unreleased] without the new feature, although CHANGELOG.md says that section collects unreleased changes. The new tests sit inside the vitest include globs and reuse the repo's fixtures. I could not run svelte-check or the tests, and I found nothing in the patches that would obviously fail them.

unmet_requirements: Step 1 / s1_ci: the workflows' actions use major-version tags (`actions/checkout@v4`, etc.), not full commit SHAs, and RELEASING.md treats SHA pinning as optional
Step 1 / s1_ci: pages.yml also has `workflow_dispatch` with no main-only guard, so the workflow does not itself restrict deploys to main or tags
strengths: The compare feature is built from the repository's own modules (viewportFor/fullSectionPath, caseOuterProfile, FIELD_LABELS/FIELD_UNITS/orderedFields, formatValue, displayNumber, NativeSelect), with logic split cleanly between lib/core, lib/render2d and site/src/lib
Data-backed tests cover the requirements: dimension filtering, ordering, units, float noise, overlay geometry (scale, head alignment, one axis), malformed routes, and in step 3 the delta L / R3 cases

A complete, consistent release setup: version in site/package.json, a tag-triggered release that checks tag, package, lockfile and changelog agree, Keep a Changelog stated, Dependabot, Conventional Commits enforced on PR titles and followed in every commit
issues: The GitHub Actions are pinned to major tags, not full commit SHAs, and RELEASING.md explicitly calls SHA pinning optional
pages.yml accepts `workflow_dispatch` from any ref with no guard, so restricting deploys to main relies on repository environment settings rather than the workflow

The compare feature and the step 3 fix never reach CHANGELOG.md's [Unreleased] section (the stated policy leaves it to maintainers at release time). Step 3 made no change for the alignment point, which was already met by step 2's CSS, and the commit does not record that it was checked
review.verdict: The compare view is correct, well tested and built from the repository's existing modules. The step 3 bug fix is clean, and the alignment the reviewer asked for was already in step 2's CSS. The step 1 setup is thorough and consistent, but the actions are not pinned to commit SHAs and the Pages workflow can be dispatched from any branch, so it needs a small CI hardening pass before merge.
